signStatePayload is an HMAC-SHA256 over the OAuth state cookie (randomBytes(24) nonce) keyed by the session secret: message authentication, not password storage.
createSign("SHA256") makes the ES256 signature on the Sign in with Apple client-secret JWT from the configured .p8 key; no password is hashed.
